observations: Stainless steel ice cream machine with a clear plastic lid secured by four black knobs.
Front panel has a blue sticker with Chinese characters and the brand name 'YIKAFU' visible.
Below the brand name, 'ice-cream' is written in English.
A digital control panel with buttons and a small display is on the right side.
The machine has a power cord with a three-prong plug hanging in front.
The machine appears to be in a storage or workshop environment with cardboard and other items in the background.
The front panel has a large sticker with images of ice cream cones and the text 'BUY MORE LIMITED' watermarked over it.
The machine shows signs of use: minor scratches and smudges on the stainless steel surface.

claims.claim: Neary used batch ice cream machine
claims.evidence: The machine shows signs of use, but 'neary used' is subjective and not verifiable from the photo alone. No proof of usage history or condition beyond surface appearance.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine turning on, cooling cycle, and dispensing ice cream.

risks.risk: The power cord may be damaged or incompatible with Nigerian outlets.
risks.proof: Close-up of the plug and socket compatibility, and a test video of the machine powering on.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional or requiring repair

risks.risk: Internal components (compressor, mixing bowl, refrigerant) may be worn or faulty.
risks.proof: Interior view of the machine with the lid open, showing the mixing bowl and motor.

proof_requests: Video of the machine turning on and operating.
Close-up of the power plug and socket compatibility.
Interior view with lid open to show mixing bowl and motor condition.
Proof of usage history or maintenance records if available.
response.reason: The machine is identifiable as a YIKAFU ice cream machine, but its functional condition, internal state, and compatibility with Nigerian power cannot be confirmed from the single photo. Without proof of operation and internal condition, it cannot be priced reliably.
